origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that each remaining Partial be structurally reviewed rather than mechanically deleted or split.

state.current_summary: VisionToolVerificationGuideView Partial의 concrete owner 감사와 focused source/build/WPF/monitor/documentation evidence가 완료되었다. 기존 dependency-property visual adapter와 presenter/shell boundaries를 no-change로 유지하고 PL-0054를 resolved로 닫는다.

objective.summary: Audit VisionToolVerificationGuideView's Partial structure and retain it only if existing dependency-property, presenter, shell, binding, and lifetime owners provide a complete boundary without a new split.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not add a service, interface, manager, wrapper, forwarding Partial, or ViewModel split for file length alone.
Preserve Verification Guide dependency properties, XAML names, automation IDs, compact-density projection, shared Tool shell composition, and presenter state writes.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current/intended owners, caller path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public/test contract, shortest reading order, and the reason no production split is justified.

The source contract proves that VisionToolVerificationGuideView has no direct persistence/file-dialog/OpenCV/Recipe/algorithm coupling and that existing presenters, shared shell, XAML contract, and representative consumers are wired.

Focused Debug/Release contracts and builds plus shared Blob/Contour/Matching WPF smoke and dynamic monitor geometry pass; broader theme/DPI/input/native Tool/camera/SDK/GPU/inspection runtime remains explicitly unverified.

artifacts.summary: Owner map, no-change structural decision, verification and unverified runtime boundaries.
Debug/Release source contracts, builds, shared-shell WPF prechecks, screenshots, and monitor geometry.

evidence.observation: VisionToolVerificationGuideView remains a required XAML/presentation adapter. Its dependency properties, automation/text/brush projection, tooltip/trimming and IsCompactMode density projection contain no file/dialog/OpenCV/Recipe/algorithm coupling or independent mutable business state. Area and matching verification presenters write guide state policy; the shared single-input Tool shell owns ToolContent, visibility, and compact-density routing; representative Blob/Contour/Edge/Matching consumers reuse the same composition. No independent production seam was found.

VisionToolVerificationGuidePartialBoundaryContract passed all 12/12 source checks in Debug and Release. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug completed with zero errors and two existing MSB3270 processor-architecture warnings; Release completed with zero warnings and zero errors.

Debug and Release RunUiPrecheck passed the shared Blob, Contour, and Matching docked verification targets with OK results, layout/text/internal diagnostics at zero, and fresh 1600x900 PNG evidence. Readiness Debug/Release, RefactorAudit, DocumentationIndex, LLM index parse, and git diff --check also passed.

Dynamic Debug and Release monitor probes detected two monitors and selected the smaller-left \\.\DISPLAY2 with bounds X=-1920,Y=365,1920x1080. Each shared-shell smoke window was explicitly moved to that working area; MoveSucceeded is true, IntersectingWindowCount is 1, IntersectsSelectedMonitor is true, and the target PNG was produced without an error artifact. Full theme/DPI/input, native Tool/file association, camera/SDK/GPU, actual inspection execution/persistence and long-running runtime remain unverified.

events.summary: VisionToolVerificationGuideView Partial은 dependency-property/XAML presentation adapter이며, area/matching verification presenters와 shared Tool shell이 policy, mutable writes, composition, and lifetime boundaries를 이미 제공한다. 새 seam 없이 분리하면 forwarding wrapper나 WPF control leakage가 되므로 no-change로 유지한다.

PL-0054의 세 completion criteria가 current source, contract, build, WPF smoke, monitor, and documentation evidence로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. 전체 theme/DPI/input, native Tool/file association, camera/SDK/GPU, actual inspection execution/persistence 및 long-running native runtime은 이 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

The Verification Guide View Partial retained-owner audit found no independent boundary that justified a production split; focused source/build/WPF/monitor/documentation evidence was recorded. Do not reopen without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency/lifetime boundary.
